## What is it?

Describe the provider and the material in plain language.

## What does it teach?

List observable learning outcomes. Avoid vague promises such as "become an expert".

## Where does it fit in the CINS sequence?

State which module(s) it supports. If the resource combines topics from multiple stages, name the exact sections to use and what to defer.

## Prerequisites

List the knowledge, account, hardware, software, and time requirements that are actually stated or verified.

## How to use it

Give a recommended sequence. Do not copy paid course content, private walkthroughs, or copyrighted lesson text.
